f_Sun_0.text: Sun. The Sun is a star! About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside it.

f_Mercury_0.text: Mercury. Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.

f_Venus_0.text: Venus. A day on Venus is longer than its whole year!

f_Mars_0.text: Mars. Mars looks red because of rusty dust.

f_Jupiter_0.text: Jupiter. Jupiter is the biggest planet. About 1,300 Earths could fit inside!

f_Uranus_0.text: Uranus. Uranus spins tipped over on its side.

f_Neptune_0.text: Neptune. Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun.

lab_earth.text: A blue home with a tilted axis. One side faces daylight; the other turns into night.

lab_moon.text: One rocky companion, many changing shapes. The Moon reflects sunlight; it does not make its own.

lab_seasons.text: Move Earth around the Sun. See how tilt changes daylight. Then try an Earth with no tilt.

lab_phases.text: Move the Moon and watch from Earth. The Sun lights half the Moon. We see different amounts of that sunlit half.

lab_compare.text: Compare two nearby worlds. Your mass stays the same, but gravity changes your weight.

lab_try.text: Change one thing. Watch what happens. Then ask why.

lab_day.text: Turn the globe to find the boundary between day and night. Earth spins into sunlight and out again. The axis guide tilts about 23.4 degrees.

trip_earth.text: Our adventure starts at home. Tap Earth, the blue world!

trip_earth_found.text: You found our home! Earth has one Moon. Let’s visit it.

trip_moon.text: The Moon goes around Earth. Can you tap the Moon? You can use the Visit Moon button too.

trip_moon_found.text: Hello, Moon! Look at those craters. Rocks from space made these dents. The Moon is much farther from Earth than we show here.

trip_mars.text: Let’s zoom out to meet our neighbours. Find Mars, the red planet. Use Show me if you need a hand.

trip_mars_found.text: There is Mars! Rust in its rocks and dust makes it look red. You found another world!

trip_saturn.text: Now look for Saturn, the world with big, bright rings. Use Show me if you need a hand.

trip_saturn_found.text: You found Saturn! Its rings are made of many pieces of ice and rock.

trip_retry.text: A different world! Let’s look together.

trip_done.text: What an adventure! Earth, the Moon, Mars, and Saturn. Explore on your own now, or tap Replay to travel again.

trip_explore.text: Tap a world to discover a fact. Tap Adventure whenever you want our trip again.
